messages.subject: Dodge Linerange by a factor?
parts:
Hi,

is there a way to use and the linerange geom? I have a discrete abscissa and a continuous ordinate and would like to have a few lineranges within each of the discrete elements on the abscissa. 

Here's an example:
Lower <- c(.1, .15, .4, .5)
Upper <- c(.2, .2, .6, .7)
K <- c(1,1,2,2)
M <- c(1,2,1,2)
tmp <- data.frame(Lower=Lower, Upper=Upper, K=as.factor(K), M=as.factor(M))
g <- ggplot(data=tmp, aes(x=K, ymin=Lower, ymax=Upper, group=M))
g <- g + geom_linerange(position=position_dodge()) 
print(g)

The two lineranges for each M (within each K) overlap. Is there a (neat?) way to dodge them?

Thanks so much!
